scope: Illustrative US retail label snapshots, not a ranking, medical endorsement, live inventory or personal regimen. Separate commercial label/price data from clinical sources. No affiliate links.

clinical_context.rule: Assess food plus supplement; distinguish folic acid from DFE, elemental iron from compound mass, DHA from total omega-3, and AI/RDA from UL.
Supplements not preapproved for safety and effectiveness; quality mark does not establish clinical efficacy.
